description.narrative:
The overall objective of the proposed programme is to contribute to sustainable peace building and democratization in the Somali region by strengthening citizen and stakeholder engagement in governance and conflict prevention and management through inclusive, participatory, citizen-centred processes and mechanisms.
The agreement paratner, Puntland Democracy and Research Center (PDRC) and sub partners Academy for Peace and Development (APD) and Horn Center (HC) aspire to participate in peacebuilding and reconstruction of Somalia; and to contribute to the creation of a democratic system of government, social and economic development, and respect of human rights for all. The primary objective of Sida's support is to provide program support to the implementation of programme "Road to Sustainable Peacebuilding & Good Governance 2022-2025.
The strategic objectives are as follows: - To contribute to peace, and human security which could contribute to reconstruction and development. - To provide a neutral forum for peace building and reconciliation through dialogue among key actors (government authorities, civil society, private sector & international actors). - To conduct evidence-based research and analysis that identifies development problems and priorities. - To inform public policy and to help develop conscious strategies and options for inclusive and sustainable development.

description.narrative:
Puntland Development and Research Center (PDRC) has provided annual and semi-annual reports with description of activities and results in the Road to Peace (R2P) programme. A selection of the results reported by PDRC on behalf of themselves and their sub-grantees Acadamy for Peace and Development (APD) and Horn Center (HC) is listed below. The reports contain more results, but these are selected as a fairly comprehensive overview of the reported results.
The results presented do not follow the same logic as the objectives above, but rather the outcomes as they have been presented in the annual workplans. The outcomes were designed to be in line with the objectives.
Outcome 1: Reduced Internal & Cross-border Tensions
The R2P consortium has facilitated peace dialogues, reconciliation conferences, and the formation of peace committees in conflict-prone areas. They highlight the following achievements:
Puntland: The resolution of a conflict in Sherbi led to the safe return of displaced residents, while the establishment of buffer zones in Mudug helped curb inter-clan clashes.
Somaliland: The Cross-Border Peace Committee was established to mediate disputes in Sool and Sanaag, contributing to a 39.44% reduction in conflicts.
Galmudug: Mediation efforts in Laas-Xaadow prevented large-scale clan violence.
Outcome 2: Civic Education on Good Governance
The programme facilitated civic engagement forums, voter education initiatives, and governance training sessions to enhance political participation. In Puntland, the program supported local council capacity-building, while in Somaliland and Galmudug, citizen engagement forums improved government accountability and service delivery awareness.
Outcome 3: Strengthening Community Governance and Local Councils
The programme supported research and capacity-building for newly elected local councils in Puntland, enhancing their governance and financial management capabilities. In Somaliland, the program contributed to improved district planning through community-driven governance initiatives. Galmudug saw the successful integration of traditional and formal governance structures, which according to the partner has increased trust in local leadership.
